title: The perpendicular bisector of AB
caption: The midpoint of AB is (4, 1) and the gradient of AB is −2, so the bisector has gradient ½ through (4, 1): y = ½x − 1.
alt: The segment from A(2, 5) to B(6, −3), its midpoint M(4, 1) and the perpendicular line y = x/2 − 1 through M.
description: The gradient of AB is −8/4 = −2, so the perpendicular gradient is 1/2.
The line through (4, 1) with gradient 1/2 is y = ½x − 1.

checks.name: M(4, 1) is the midpoint of AB
the line y = ½x − 1 is perpendicular to AB
